verdict.rationale: Dagster ships an official AI skill (dagster-expert) that gives external coding agents patterns for building Dagster projects. Dagster can also wrap dlt sources as assets, so an agent could plausibly draft ingestion code that the user reviews. But nothing in the evidence shows AI generating a working connector from API documentation, and the result depends on an outside coding agent plus a separate ingestion library. Missing for 10: any documented AI connector-builder flow, generation from API docs, handling of auth/pagination/streams, a review-and-ship workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
